title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12275)
clause_1_scope: This standard applies to time-to-amplitude converters (TAC) used in conjunction with multichannel amplitude analyzers (MCA) in the measurement of time intervals. A common application of this technique is in time-of-flight measurements, coincidence measurements, pulse shape discrimination technique, etc.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
